description: PgWire smoke passed 18/18 after adding JDBC-style catalog probes for server_version, pg_database, pg_attribute, and wildcard pg_namespace.
PgWire metadata fast-path now covers SHOW server_version/server_encoding and current_setting for common connection settings.
Virtual PostgreSQL catalog expanded with pg_database and pg_attribute plus wider pg_namespace/pg_class fields needed by driver metadata discovery.
Move from raw-socket catalog smoke to a real JDBC/pgbench/tool smoke when local artifacts are available, and make external readiness report consume the new PgWire evidence.
